description: Type: new feature or behaviour — feat PR

description: Type: modernisation / paying down deferred work — refactor or perf PR

description: Type: tooling, config, dependencies, CI — chore or ci PR

name: documentation
description: Type: docs, rule docs, design docs — docs PR

description: Area: React SPA under src/ui

name: e2e
description: Area: Playwright suite under e2e/

name: infra
description: Area: docker-compose, Authentik, databases, local stack

name: ci
description: Area: GitHub Actions, hooks, agent skills and workflow tooling

name: diet-planner

name: ui-shell

name: priority:high

name: priority:medium
description: Planned

name: priority:low
